rateLimits.note: Wikimedia's rate limits of 2026 (mediawiki.org/wiki/Wikimedia_APIs/Rate_limits, "subject to experimentation and change"): 200 requests a minute for an unauthenticated client with a compliant User-Agent, 10 a minute per IP for an unidentified one. The robot policy also asks one request at a time on the Action API, below 5 a second, and 5 s of pause after a request that took more than 1 s. A 429 or 503 with Retry-After is honoured.

attribution.text: Data from Wikidata (CC0); pictures from Wikimedia Commons under their own licences

provenance.notes: Structured data under CC0 (no attribution required; "Powered by Wikidata" is welcome). Pictures from Wikimedia Commons keep each file's own licence and credit, on its description page. Every request names the client, its version and a contact in its User-Agent ("CoolBot/0.0 (https://example.org/coolbot/; coolbot@example.org) generic-library/0.0", foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:User-Agent_policy); a missing or generic one is refused (403). The API may not be sublicensed or leased. Serial requests and maxlag for batch work (mediawiki.org/wiki/API:Etiquette); wikitech.wikimedia.org/wiki/Robot_policy.
